calculation.description: Ranks assets that have recently fallen over three sessions more highly, scaling the reversal by recent 20-session return volatility. Computed using information available at each signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.046682, 765 observations), 2023-2024 (+0.025609, 516), and 2025-2027 (+0.035387, 574). Daily admission gates are absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Five- and ten-day decay is weaker, so use primarily for short holding horizons.
validation.methodology: Cross-sectional Spearman correlation between signal and next-session close-to-close return; each date required at least 8 valid instruments. Universe contained 15 tradable benchmark instruments; no future data used.
